content: प्रत्यक्ष {%a.%} [अक्ष्णःप्रति] .²1 Perceptible (to the eye), visible; प्रत्यक्षाभिः प्रपन्नस्तनुभिरवतु वस्ताभिरष्टाभिरीशः <ls>Ś. 1. 1</ls>. .²2 Present, in sight, before the eye. .²3 Cognizable by any organ of sense. .²4 Distinct, evident, clear. .²5 Direct, immediate. .²6 Explicit, express. .²7 Corporeal. .{@-क्षम्@} .²1 Perception, ocular evidence, apprehension by the senses, considered as a प्रमाण or mode of proof; इन्द्रियार्थसंनिकर्षजन्यं ज्ञानं प्रत्यक्षम् <ls>T. S.</ls> .²2 Explicitness, distinctness. .²3 Superintendence, care for; प्रत्यहं लोकयात्रायाः प्रत्यक्षं स्त्रीनिबन्धनम् <ls>Ms. 9. 27</ls>. .²4 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) A kind of style descriptive of impressions derived from the senses. (The forms प्रत्यक्षम्, प्रत्यक्षेण, प्रत्यक्षतः, प्रत्यक्षात् are used adverbially in the sense of .²1 Before, in the presence of, in the sight of. .²2 Openly, publicly. .²3 Directly, immediately. Hence; प्रत्यक्षतोदृष्टसम्बन्धम् is a variety of अनुमान where the connection between the लिङ्ग and the लिङ्गिन् or साध्य is directly perceived; प्रत्यक्षतो दृष्टसम्बन्धं यथा धूमाकृतिदर्शनादग्न्याकृतिविज्ञानम् <ls>ŚB. on MS. 1. 1. 5</ls>. .²4 Personally. .²5 At sight. .²6 Explicitly. .²7 Distinctly, clearly. .²8 Literally. So प्रत्यक्षे in the sight of, before the eyes of.)
